integrity.calculations: Exact rational and exhaustive permutation checks provided in check.py.
integrity.mathematical_claim: One theorem on rank-two matroid base polytope angular spectra, two-direction collision extremizers, and a two-face-count separation.

scientific_limitations: Strict Schur-convexity is proved for the second Gaussian normal-cone collision moment only.
Conclusions concern the canonical Euclidean zero-one embedding, not general affine images or nonisotropic objectives.
Two face-count twins are not claimed to have identical face lattices.
Novelty is assessed against checked sources, not independently established.
title: Gaussian angular spectra and a sharp balance law for rank-two matroid base polytopes
